```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(duckplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)
library(govhr)

# downloads Roboto from Google Fonts (if needed) and registers it with
# systemfonts, so ragg can find it
systemfonts::require_font("Roboto")

theme_set(
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14,
    base_family = "Roboto"
  ) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
)

source(
  here::here("R", "analysis.R")
)

source(
  here::here("R", "harmonize.R")
)

source(
  here::here("R", "occupation.R")
)

source(
  here::here("R", "plot.R")
)

set.seed(2026)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  here::here("data", "data-clean", "govhr_pry.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)

pry_est <- tbl(con, "pry_est")
pry_personnel <- tbl(con, "pry_personnel")
pry_contracts <- tbl(con, "pry_contracts")

pry_personnel <- pry_personnel |>
  mutate(
    ref_date = as.Date(ref_date)
  ) |>
  filter(
    ref_date >= as.Date("2016-01-01"),
    ref_date <= as.Date("2025-12-01")
  )
```

# Workforce

```{r}
#| label: workforce-data
#| include: false
pry_est_judicial <- pry_est |>
  filter(
    adm1 == "PODER JUDICIAL" &
      adm2 == "CORTE SUPREMA DE JUSTICIA"
  )

pry_contracts_judicial <- pry_contracts |>
  inner_join(
    pry_est_judicial,
    by = c("est_id", "ref_date")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ref_date = as.Date(ref_date),
    whours = as.double(whours)
  ) |>
  # there seems to be data gaps before 2016
  filter(
    ref_date >= as.Date("2016-01-01"),
    ref_date <= as.Date("2025-12-01")
  ) |>
  classify_occupation_group()
```

## Overview

- This presentation focuses on workforce and wage bill analytics for the justice sector of Paraguay, focusing on the Supreme Court of Justice.
- The data spans from January 2016 through December 2025.
- On average, there are 13-15 thousand workers in the Justice sector.
- While most of our analysis treats the sector as a whole, some of the analysis focuses on specific occupation groups: juez de paz, juez de primera instancia y miembro de tribunal.

## Main findings

- The headcount in the justice sector has remained stable over time.
- Wages, in real terms, have declined. This decline has been driven primarily by a lack of adjustment in base salaries.
- The wage bill has remained stable. This stability is due to the offsetting effects of declining wages and growing headcount.
- There are gender disparities in employment and wages. In general, women receive lower wages, likely because their employment is concentrated in lower-paying occupations (e.g., juez de paz).

## Headcount

```{r}
#| label: headcount
headcount <- pry_contracts_judicial |>
  compute_headcount() |>
  collect()

headcount |>
  plot_line(
    x_col = "ref_date",
    y_col = "headcount",
    x_lab = "Time",
    y_lab = "Headcount"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::comma_format()
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(1.2e4, 1.5e4)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Headcount"
  )
```

## Headcount by occupation group

```{r}
#| label: headcount-by-occupation-group
headcount_by_occupation_group <- pry_contracts_judicial |>
  compute_headcount(
    group_cols = c("occupation_group")
  ) |>
  collect()

headcount_by_occupation_group |>
  filter(
    occupation_group != "Otros"
  ) |>
  plot_line(
    "ref_date",
    "headcount",
    group_col = "occupation_group",
    x_lab = "Time",
    y_lab = "Headcount"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Occupation Group",
    values = c(
      "Miembro de Tribunal" = "#202d85",
      "Juez de Primera Instancia" = "#de4500",
      "Juez de Paz" = "#f2a541"
    )
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      title = "Occupation Group",
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  )
```

## Headcount by age group

```{r}
#| label: headcount-by-age-group
headcount_by_age <- pry_personnel |>
  inner_join(
    pry_contracts_judicial |>
      distinct(personnel_id, ref_date),
    by = c("personnel_id", "ref_date")
  ) |>
  compute_headcount(
    group_cols = c("age")
  ) |>
  collect()

headcount_by_age_group <- headcount_by_age |>
  filter(
    !is.na(age)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    age = as.numeric(age)
  ) |>
  classify_age_group() |>
  summarise(
    headcount = sum(headcount),
    .by = c(ref_date, age_group)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    share_headcount = headcount / sum(headcount, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = ref_date
  )

headcount_by_age_group |>
  plot_area(
    x = ref_date,
    y = share_headcount,
    fill = age_group,
    xlab = "Year",
    ylab = "Share of Headcount"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format()
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Age Group",
    values = c(
      "<30" = "#202d85",
      "30-39" = "#de4500",
      "40-49" = "#f2a541",
      "50-59" = "#47b679",
      "60+" = "#8c8c8c"
    )
  )
```

## Decomposition of headcount change by age group

```{r}
#| label: movement-decomposition-by-age-group
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
movement_decomposition_by_age_group <- movement_by_age_group |>
  arrange(ref_date) |>
  mutate(
    net_change = headcount - lag(headcount, order_by = ref_date),
    net_aging = net_change - (hires - separations),
    .by = age_group
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(net_change)
  )

movement_decomposition_by_age_group |>
  mutate(
    separations = -separations
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    c(hires, separations, net_aging),
    names_to = "component",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(x = ref_date)
  ) +
  geom_col(
    aes(
      y = value,
      fill = component
    ),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.1,
    position = "stack"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Component",
    labels = c(
      "hires" = "Hires",
      "separations" = "Separations",
      "net_aging" = "Transitions through aging"
    ),
    values = c(
      "hires" = "#202d85",
      "separations" = "#de4500",
      "net_aging" = "#f2a541"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 year",
    date_labels = "%Y"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Change in Headcount"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    vars(age_group),
    ncol = 2
  )
```

# Transitions

## Transitions across occupations

A random sample of 30 occupations.

```{r}
#| label: transitions-by-occupation
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 12
transitions_occupation <- pry_contracts_judicial |>
  compute_transition(
    id_col = "personnel_id",
    group_col = "occupation"
  ) |>
  collect()

sample_occupation <- transitions_occupation |>
  distinct(from) |>
  slice_sample(n = 30) |>
  pull(from)

transitions_occupation |>
  filter(
    from %in% sample_occupation |
      to %in% sample_occupation
  ) |>
  plot_transition(
    weight_col = "transitions",
    legend = FALSE
  )
```

## Transitions between occupation groups

```{r}
#| label: transitions-by-occupation-alluvial
transitions_occupation_group |>
  summarise(
    transitions = sum(transitions),
    .by = c(from, to)
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      axis1 = from,
      axis2 = to,
      y = transitions
    )
  ) +
  geom_alluvium(
    aes(fill = from)
  ) +
  geom_stratum() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
    stat = "stratum"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("Original occupation", "Next occupation")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::comma
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Original occupation",
    values = c(
      "Juez de Paz" = "#202d85",
      "Juez de Primera Instancia" = "#de4500",
      "Miembro de Tribunal" = "#f2a541",
      "Otros" = "#6c757d"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Transitions"
  )
```

## Transitions between occupation groups by gender

```{r}
#| label: transitions-by-occupation-gender-alluvial
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 10
transitions_occupation_gender <- pry_contracts_judicial |>
  detect_transition(
    id_col = "personnel_id",
    group_col = "occupation_group"
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    pry_personnel |> select(personnel_id, ref_date, gender),
    by = c("personnel_id", "ref_date")
  ) |>
  collect()

transitions_occupation_gender |>
  summarise(
    transitions = n(),
    .by = c(from, to, gender)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    transition_rate = transitions / sum(transitions, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = gender
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      axis1 = from,
      axis2 = to,
      y = transition_rate
    )
  ) +
  geom_alluvium(
    aes(fill = from)
  ) +
  geom_stratum(
    width = 1/2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = after_stat(
        stringr::str_wrap(stratum, width = 20)
      )
    ),
    stat = "stratum"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("Original occupation", "Next occupation")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Original occupation",
    values = c(
      "Juez de Paz" = "#202d85",
      "Juez de Primera Instancia" = "#de4500",
      "Miembro de Tribunal" = "#f2a541",
      "Otros" = "#6c757d"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Transitions"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    vars(gender),
    ncol = 1
  )
```

# Wage bill

```{r}
#| label: wagebill-data
#| include: false
# deflating here rather than in workforce-data keeps the CPI join out of the
# workforce queries, which never touch wages
pry_contracts_judicial_real <- pry_contracts_judicial |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(base_salary_lcu, allowance_lcu, gross_salary_lcu),
      as.double
    )
  ) |>
  deflate_wages(
    wage_cols = c("base_salary_lcu", "allowance_lcu", "gross_salary_lcu"),
    country_code = "PRY"
  )
```

## Wage bill

```{r}
#| label: wagebill
wagebill <- pry_contracts_judicial_real |>
  mutate(
    employment_status = "active"
  ) |>
  compute_wagebill(
    measure_col = "gross_salary_lcu"
  ) |>
  collect()

wagebill |>
  plot_line(
    x_col = "ref_date",
    x_lab = "Year",
    y_col = "wagebill",
    y_lab = "Wagebill (real ₲, Dec 2021)"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, NA)
  )
```

## Wage bill by salary component

```{r}
#| label: wagebill-by-salary-component
wagebill_salary <- pry_contracts_judicial_real |>
  mutate(
    employment_status = "active"
  ) |>
  compute_wagebill(
    measure_col = "base_salary_lcu"
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  select(
    ref_date,
    wagebill_base_salary = wagebill,
    growth_base_salary = wagebill_growth
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    pry_contracts_judicial_real |>
      mutate(
        employment_status = "active"
      ) |>
      compute_wagebill(
        measure_col = "allowance_lcu"
      ) |>
      collect() |>
      select(
        ref_date,
        wagebill_allowance = wagebill,
        growth_allowance = wagebill_growth
      ),
    by = "ref_date"
  )

wagebill_salary |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    c(wagebill_base_salary, wagebill_allowance),
    names_to = "component",
    values_to = "wagebill"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    component = recode(
      component,
      "wagebill_base_salary" = "Base Salary",
      "wagebill_allowance" = "Allowances"
    ) |>
      forcats::fct_relevel(
        "Base Salary",
        "Allowances"
      )
  ) |>
  plot_trend(
    group_col = c("component"),
    y_col = "wagebill",
    y_label = "Wagebill (real ₲, Dec 2021)"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Salary Component",
    values = c(
      "Base Salary" = "#202d85",
      "Allowances" = "#de4500"
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    vars(component)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, NA)
  )
```

## Wage bill growth by salary component

```{r}
#| label: wagebill-growth-by-salary-component
wagebill_salary |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    c(growth_base_salary, growth_allowance),
    names_to = "component",
    values_to = "growth_rate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    component = recode(
      component,
      "growth_base_salary" = "Base Salary",
      "growth_allowance" = "Allowances"
    ) |>
      forcats::fct_relevel(
        "Base Salary",
        "Allowances"
      )
  ) |>
  plot_change(
    x_col = "ref_date",
    x_lab = "Year",
    y_col = "growth_rate",
    y_lab = "Wagebill Growth Rate",
    group_col = "component"
  )
```

## Decomposition of wage bill growth

```{r}
#| label: wagebill-growth-decomposition
wagebill_growth_decomposition <- pry_contracts_judicial_real |>
  compute_growth_decomposition(
    measure_col = "base_salary_lcu"
  ) |>
  collect()

wagebill_growth_decomposition |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    c(employment_effect, wage_effect, interaction_effect),
    names_to = "effect_type",
    values_to = "effect_value"
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = ref_date,
      y = effect_value,
      fill = effect_type,
      group = effect_type
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(
    position = "stack"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Effect Type",
    labels = c(
      "employment_effect" = "Employment Effect",
      "wage_effect" = "Compensation Effect",
      "interaction_effect" = "Interaction Effect"
    ),
    values = c(
      "employment_effect" = "#202d85",
      "wage_effect" = "#de4500",
      "interaction_effect" = "#f5a623"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Time",
    y = "Magnitude of Effect"
  )
```

## Wage bill share by salary component

```{r}
#| label: wagebill-share-by-component
wagebill_salary |>
  mutate(
    total_wagebill = wagebill_base_salary + wagebill_allowance,
    share_base_salary = wagebill_base_salary / total_wagebill,
    share_allowance = wagebill_allowance / total_wagebill
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    c(share_base_salary, share_allowance),
    names_to = "component",
    values_to = "share_wagebill"
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = ref_date,
      y = share_wagebill,
      fill = component,
      group = component
    )
  ) +
  geom_area(
    position = "stack"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Wagebill Component",
    labels = c(
      "share_base_salary" = "Base Salary",
      "share_allowance" = "Allowances"
    ),
    values = c(
      "share_base_salary" = "#202d85",
      "share_allowance" = "#de4500"
    )
  )
```

# Compensation

## Average wage

```{r}
#| label: wage
pry_compensation <- pry_contracts_judicial_real |>
  compute_wage(
    measure_col = "gross_salary_lcu"
  ) |>
  collect()

pry_compensation |>
  plot_trend(
    group_col = c("ref_date"),
    y_col = "wage",
    y_label = "Average wage"
  )
```

## Average wage by salary component

```{r}
#| label: wage-by-salary-component
pry_wage_by_component <- pry_contracts_judicial_real |>
  compute_wage(
    measure_col = "base_salary_lcu"
  ) |>
  select(
    ref_date,
    wage_base_salary = wage
  ) |>
  left_join(
    pry_contracts_judicial_real |>
      compute_wage(
        measure_col = "allowance_lcu"
      ) |>
      select(
        ref_date,
        wage_allowance = wage
      ),
    by = "ref_date"
  ) |>
  collect()

pry_wage_by_component |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    c(wage_base_salary, wage_allowance),
    names_to = "component",
    values_to = "wage"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    component = recode(
      component,
      "wage_base_salary" = "Base Salary",
      "wage_allowance" = "Allowances"
    ) |>
      forcats::fct_relevel(
        "Base Salary",
        "Allowances"
      )
  ) |>
  plot_trend(
    group_col = c("component"),
    y_col = "wage",
    y_label = "Average wage (real ₲, Dec 2021)"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Salary Component",
    values = c(
      "Base Salary" = "#202d85",
      "Allowances" = "#de4500"
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    vars(component)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Average wage by contract type

```{r}
#| label: wage-by-contract-type
pry_wage_by_contract <- pry_contracts_judicial_real |>
  filter(
    !is.na(contract_type)
  ) |>
  compute_wage(
    measure_col = "gross_salary_lcu",
    group_cols = c("contract_type")
  ) |>
  collect()

pry_wage_by_contract |>
  mutate(
    contract_type = forcats::fct_relevel(
      contract_type,
      "permanent",
      "fixed-term"
    ) |>
      recode(
        "permanent" = "Permanent",
        "fixed-term" = "Fixed-Term"
      )
  ) |>
  plot_trend(
    group_col = c("contract_type"),
    y_col = "wage",
    y_label = "Average wage (real ₲, Dec 2021)"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1,
    color = "#f5a623"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Type of Contract",
    values = c(
      "Fixed-Term" = "#de4500",
      "Permanent" = "#202d85"
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    vars(contract_type)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Wage distribution

